admin.rewards_screen.subtitle: Every feature that pays: its money, how it is paid and its items. Each change saves like a setting and is in the audit log.
admin.rewards_screen.items_on: On: the items below are given (under the daily item and value caps).
admin.rewards_screen.items_off: Off: no item below is given until you turn item rewards on. Money still pays.
admin.rewards_screen.empty: No feature that pays was found in the settings.
admin.rewards_screen.card_hint.missions: What each mission type pays the officers, and its item pool.
admin.rewards_screen.card_hint.pvp: Cases with real players as suspects: the officers' pay and the volunteer suspect's own pay.
admin.rewards_screen.card_hint.team: Field training and supervisor point awards.
admin.rewards_screen.hint.type: Paid to every officer of a finished run of this type.
admin.rewards_screen.hint.live: The officers of a live case, like a mission of its type.
admin.rewards_screen.hint.volunteer_case: The officers of a mission a volunteer played, like any mission of its type.
admin.rewards_screen.hint.suspect: The volunteer who played the suspect, once per fair case, by how it ended.
admin.rewards_screen.hint.surrender: The officer who talked a live-case suspect down, once per peaceful arrest.
admin.rewards_screen.hint.ftoSignOff: The trainer, for each task he signs off.
admin.rewards_screen.hint.ftoComplete: The rookie, once his training is done.
admin.rewards_screen.hint.supAward: The officer a supervisor gives points to, per point.
admin.rewards_screen.money.from_type: Pays the case's mission type payout (see NPC missions).
admin.rewards_screen.items_from_type: On: the case rolls its mission type's item pool too.
admin.rewards_screen.bytype_hint: An empty box pays the amount above.
